summary: The candidate stays within the writable-file scope, but it omits approved review semantics and introduces unsupported technical constraints and acceptance criteria.

issues.issue: REQ-MENU-033–036 are not fully preserved: there is no changeId-scoped pending-change model, no explicit disabled-option dependency or recipe-adoption rule, and E-21 accepts only one configurationId instead of explicitly selected one-or-many configurations.
issues.required_fix: Model observed change IDs/reasons and token snapshots, preserve concurrent changes, include the disabled-option and recipe-adoption rules, and align E-19/E-20/E-21 and the data model.

issues.issue: Menu is given a normative Transactional Outbox and delivery guarantee, but the authorized sources assign that outbox decision to Orders' stock-movement persistence and do not establish a Menu outbox/database guarantee.
issues.required_fix: Remove the Menu-specific outbox guarantee or mark it as an unresolved implementation option; retain only source-backed logical publication and open transport/delivery details.

issues.issue: The catalog-invalidation event specifies unsupported payload fields and a concrete POS event path while OPEN-007 says event names, payloads, and transport remain unresolved.
issues.required_fix: Keep the invalidation as a logical obligation only and move recipient, fields, names, and transport to OPEN-007 unless explicitly sourced.

issues.issue: The nominal test is widened to 15–30 minutes and the burst to 30–60 seconds, contradicting the later ADR-004 decisions of 30 minutes and 60 seconds.
issues.required_fix: Use the authoritative 30-minute nominal window and 60-second burst window.

issues.issue: The specification adds maxSelections >= 1 although the approved rule only establishes 0 <= minSelections <= maxSelections; the logical model also does not consistently express this added constraint.
issues.required_fix: Remove the unsupported maxSelections lower bound, or source and apply it consistently across requirements, rules, data model, and Mermaid.

issues.issue: REQ-MENU-027/028 narrows incomplete-definition handling and warnings: it does not explicitly cover an INACTIVE MenuItemVariant context or require the affected group's/slot's identity, as the approved requirements do.
issues.required_fix: State both allowed INACTIVE contexts and include identity, type, minSelections, and calculated capacity in every warning.
